items.title: Titles are settled; Hamilton and Red Bull lead close fights for third
items.summary: The pre-Qatar Formula1.com tables after Las Vegas show Hamilton on 267 points, three ahead of Russell and Norris on 264 and 17 ahead of Leclerc on 250. Red Bull hold third in the Constructors' table on 440, nine ahead of McLaren on 431. Antonelli and Mercedes have already secured their championships; these are pre-Qatar standings and should be refreshed after that race.
items.why_it_matters: Abu Dhabi is a season finale, not a title decider. Keep the settled championships separate from the remaining-position battles and update the live points before the final round.

items.title: Camara is confirmed for Abu Dhabi; Bearman's 2027 seat is settled
items.summary: Haas confirmed that Rafael Camara will drive its final two 2026 Grands Prix, including Abu Dhabi. On 26 November, Formula1.com reported Camara's decision to leave his F2 title challenge for the final two rounds and Haas's confirmation that Oliver Bearman will stay for 2027, completing next year's grid.
items.why_it_matters: Camara's Abu Dhabi race seat is confirmed; this does not establish an FP1 rookie appearance. Keep the 2027 contract update distinct from the 2026 weekend entry.

items.title: Lindblad says Vegas spin left him emotional as he targets Racing Bulls' P5
items.summary: After spinning out while running near the front in Las Vegas, Arvid Lindblad said he had been trying not to dwell on the incident and was focused on the final two rounds. He hopes to help Racing Bulls secure fifth in the Teams' Championship. Formula1.com's account does not identify a technical cause for the spin.
items.why_it_matters: Keep Lindblad's personal account and stated team goal distinct from any inferred technical explanation.
